# Step 2: Design for Medium Devices

#### Course: Learn CSS

## Step 2: Design for Medium Devices

The design you need to create for medium devices (e.g., tablets, laptops) is:

![Responsive Navbar for Medium Devices](data:image/png;base64,)

Now, you can use a media query to add the CSS rules for medium devices (above 600px wide) as,

```css
/* For medium screen sizes */
@media (min-width: 601px) {

    .navbar {
        flex-direction: row;
    }

    .nav-links {
        display: flex;
        list-style: none;
        gap: 2rem;
    }

    .nav-links a {
        color: white;
        text-decoration: none;
        font-size: 1rem;
    }

    .icon {
        display: none;
    }
}
```

Finally, it's time to add CSS rules for even bigger devices.
